Name: JP's Run Faster Mod
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][b][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=6]Run Faster Mod[/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]


[font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]We all agree that if the hare had been smart, it would have beaten the tortoise, right?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][b]This is a simple mod that lets you adjust the speed at which you walk and run. By default, it increases your running speed by 1 point (similar to a buff that provides the same effect).[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]You can increase your speed up to 95 points (just for fun, of course! It’s impossible to control your character at that speed).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]There’s an option to have your horse inherit this speed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#ffff00][font=Georgia][b]Two bonus fixes are also included:[/b][/font][/color][/size][/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*][i][font=Georgia][size=4]One prevents the running/walking animation from glitching at very high speeds; [/size][/font][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Georgia][size=4]The other fixes a [b][color=#ff0000]camera bug[/color][/b] where the camera fails to follow you properly at high speeds (even speeds granted by a normal buff), causing a micro stutter that looks really bad.[/size][/font][/i][/*]
[/list]

[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's it, if used correctly, the mod might help you go a little faster without breaking the game; the rest are just for fun. Remember to have GMCM to configure the mod![/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[b][font=Georgia][i][u][color=#ff0000][size=5]Translations[/size][/color][/u][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. (Recommended)
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
